title: Riot X Nic Salts Cherry Berry Crush 10ml E-Liquid
description: Riot X Nic Salts Cherry Berry Crush delivers a bright and dynamic fruit profile with a playful, fizzy twist. The e-liquid captures the taste of a sherbet-style Cherry with a distinct, floral confectionery edge, providing a deeply sweet and nostalgic inhale. This sugary foundation is expertly lifted by subtle hints of zesty Lime, introducing a sweet and tart contrast that creates a highly refreshing finish. This e-liquid features Riot's Hybrid Nicotine formula, which blends Nic Salt and freebase for quick satisfaction, a smooth throat feel, and modest vapour production. With its 50VG/50PG profile, this vape juice is best suited to mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping and performs well with pod kits, refillable starter kits, and compact vape pens. Made in the UK, the Riot X Nic Salts range focuses on full-impact fruit blends designed for everyday use in low-powered refillable devices.
